title: Is The Stock Market Crashing? (What To Do Right Now)
speaker: Ricky Gutierrez

macro_themes.view: Hormuz tensions and planned post-election strikes keep oil near 112 Brent, feeding stagflation fear.
Markets oversold; upside on recovery outweighs downside, but avoid leverage and size small since things can get worse.

calls.condition: Watch 700: a flush below invalidates support, a sharp reclaim confirms an oversold bounce.
calls.reason: Approaching major 4-hour support at 700 and technically oversold; recovery potential greater than downside, but geopolitics could push lower.
calls.quote: when if and when markets do begin to recover, there's greater upside potential than potential downside risk.
